Today's selection covers 73 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 46 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic created a test marketplace for agent-on-agent commerce
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Threat actor uses Microsoft Teams to deploy new “Snow” malware
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 4 articles published in the last 24 hours
